notes: These fictional skills demonstrate the framework.

skills.name: clear-writing
skills.title: Clear writing
skills.description: Edit a short article for specific claims, active voice, and clear transitions.
skills.instructions:
# Clear writing

Read the draft. Identify its audience and central claim. Replace vague language with concrete details. Preserve the author's meaning and explain substantial edits.

skills.name: review-code
skills.title: Review code
skills.description: Review a code change for correctness, failure paths, and meaningful tests.
skills.instructions:
# Review code

Read the change and its callers. Identify concrete regressions with reproducible examples. Prioritize findings by impact. State what was checked.

skills.name: research-topic
skills.title: Research a topic
skills.description: Investigate a question using primary sources, record citations, and distinguish evidence from inference.
skills.instructions:
# Research a topic

Define the question. Find primary evidence. Record sources and dates. Identify uncertainties and summarize only what the evidence supports.
